Decrease Pollution — Protect Health

Our team unites efforts of professionals, experts, and nonprofit groups working in Eastern Europe and Central Asia to find and implement solutions to problems of toxic persistent pollutants and associated health risks.

3.content:
Our Geography

EHPMI has active teams and operates in the following countries: Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Mongolia, and Vietnam. The national teams have been present and worked in Eastern Europe and Central Asia region for over 15 years.
